notes: «- قال الحلواني حدثنا وقال عبد، حدثني -» is a gloss on the verb and «- وهو ابن إبراهيم بن سعد -» an editor gloss: both are left out, so the father of Ya'qub is not named (not filled from the gloss).
Hakim is the one who asked the Prophet and reports it («أن حكيم بن حزام أخبره»), so he is the last link.
